name: Giant
verdict: Bicycle brand of Giant Manufacturing (Giant Group, listed TPE: 9921); in September 2025 US Customs and Border Protection detained Giant's Taiwan-made bicycles under a Withhold Release Order based on forced-labour indicators.

why.text: Giant is a product brand of Giant Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (Giant Group). In September 2025 US Customs and Border Protection issued a Withhold Release Order against bicycles, parts and accessories made in Taiwan by Giant Manufacturing, based on information that reasonably indicates forced labour; CBP said its investigation identified ILO forced-labour indicators including abuse of vulnerability, abusive working and living conditions, debt bondage, withholding of wages and excessive overtime.
why.messageLine: In September 2025 US Customs ordered the detention of Giant's Taiwan-made bicycles after finding ILO forced-labour indicators including debt bondage and withholding of wages.

note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. This PR (btj-scout) had proposed 'none', but the company test in METHOD.md is not met as 'nothing found': US CBP issued a WRO against Giant Manufacturing Co. Ltd on 24 September 2025 citing forced-labour indicators (claim giant-manufacturing-forced-labour-wro-2025). Under METHOD's company test (a regulator's order finding forced labour at the company itself), this plausibly means 'concern'; only a maintainer sets the tier, so the rating is held as being-rated. Context: Giant says it adopted a zero-recruitment-fee policy in January 2025 and has repaid broker fees to migrant workers, and has petitioned CBP to modify or revoke the WRO (Bicycle Retailer, 24 Sep 2025; CommonWealth Magazine, 30 Sep 2026).
